limits: Original selected software ports only; no full Native/Host/device/cache acceptance.
A compiled variant is not a semantic negative until its original selected core consumer verifies exit2 and the original assertion.
Historical producer/replay/selector failures and the first missing-header compile failure remain preserved.

negativeCppBoundary.scope: Current CPP is byte-identical in all six actual compilations; only declared runtime predicates differ. Old whole product headers are not reused. Original two selected cases supply sole positive and semantic-negative executions.
